responsibility: This header declares the small language-independent interface used to recognize OpenMP runtime API names and calls. It provides predicates implemented in omp-general.cc for checking whether an identifier or function declaration refers to a reserved OpenMP runtime procedure, which front ends use for semantic/error checking, and it also declares the mapping helpers between internal Fortran runtime-function identifiers and their external names so the Fortran front end can share the same OpenMP API classification logic without depending on heavier OpenMP middle-end headers.
